messages.subject: INLA Installation error
parts:
Dear R-INLA team, 

I cannot install R-INLA into my R 4.1.0 for Windows 10. 
It runs a wrong message 

Rcurl.h:4:10: fatal error: curl/curl.h: No such file or directory
 #include <curl/curl.h>
          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~
compilation terminated.
make: *** [C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-41~1.0/etc/i386/Makeconf:238: base64.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'RCurl'
* removing 'C:/Users/liqt2/Documents/R/win-library/4.1/RCurl'
Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘RCurl’ had non-zero exit status. 

Please help. 
Thank you a million. 
Regards, 
Christiane

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA Installation error
parts:
Looks like the Rcurl package has system dependencies you haven’t installed. Check the CRAN page for that package. If you haven’t installed Rtools on your system, you likely need that as well. Consult the online R documentation for windows.

Finn
